brief:
Drop Site News reported that Trump extended a ceremonial reception to Chinese President Xi Jinping, rolling out a red carpet for the diplomatic meeting. The encounter signals a continuation of high-level engagement between Washington and Beijing amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.

Meanwhile, Israel has blocked the delivery of wheelchairs to amputee children in Gaza, restricting mobility assistance to some of the territory's most vulnerable civilians. The wheelchair blockade compounds the humanitarian crisis affecting Gaza's population.

In separate developments, Argentina's president threatened renewed claims over the Falkland Islands, reviving a long-standing territorial dispute with Britain over the South Atlantic archipelago.
title: Trump welcomes Xi as Israel restricts Gaza amputees' mobility
